#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_

#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is true.
 *
 * @details If the condition @p cond is false, the test fails and prints the
 *          message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param cond The condition to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the condition is false.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_true(cond, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!(cond)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is false.
 *
 * @details If the condition @p cond is true, the test fails and prints the
 *          message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param cond The condition to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the condition is true.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_false(cond, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (cond) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is NULL.
 *
 * @details If the pointer @p ptr is not NULL, the test fails and prints the
 *          message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param ptr The pointer to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointer is not NULL.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_is_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((ptr) != NULL) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is not NULL.
 *
 * @details If the pointer @p ptr is NULL, the test fails and prints the
 *          message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param ptr The pointer to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointer is NULL.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_not_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((ptr) == NULL) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two values are equal.
 *
 * @details If @p actual is not equal to @p expected, the test fails and prints
 *          the message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The actual value.
 * @param expected The expected value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_equal(actual, expected, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((actual) != (expected)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two values are not equal.
 *
 * @details If @p actual is equal to @p expected, the test fails and prints
 *          the message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The actual value.
 * @param expected The expected value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal(actual, expected, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((actual) == (expected)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are equal.
 *
 * @details If the memory block pointed to by @p actual is not equal to the
 *          memory block pointed to by @p expected for @p size bytes, the test
 *          fails and prints the message @p msg (with optional format
 *          arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The pointer to the actual memory block.
 * @param expected The pointer to the expected memory block.
 * @param size The size of the memory blocks to compare.
 * @param msg The message to print if the memory blocks are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_mem_equal(actual, expected, size, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (memcmp(actual, expected, size) != 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are not equal.
 *
 * @details If the memory block pointed to by @p actual is equal to the
 *          memory block pointed to by @p expected for @p size bytes, the test
 *          fails and prints the message @p msg (with optional format
 *          arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The pointer to the actual memory block.
 * @param expected The pointer to the expected memory block.
 * @param size The size of the memory blocks to compare.
 * @param msg The message to print if the memory blocks are equal.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_mem_not_equal(actual, expected, size, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (memcmp(actual, expected, size) == 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is within a range.
 *
 * @details If @p actual is not within the range [@p lower, @p upper],
 *          the test fails and prints the message @p msg (with optional format
 *          arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The actual value.
 * @param lower The lower bound of the range (inclusive).
 * @param upper The upper bound of the range (inclusive).
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is not within the range.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_within(actual, lower, upper, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!((actual) >= (lower) && (actual) <= (upper))) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is not within a range.
 *
 * @details If @p actual is within the range [@p lower, @p upper],
 *          the test fails and prints the message @p msg (with optional format
 *          arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The actual value.
 * @param lower The lower bound of the range (inclusive).
 * @param upper The upper bound of the range (inclusive).
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is within the range.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_not_within(actual, lower, upper, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (((actual) >= (lower) && (actual) <= (upper))) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a return code indicates success (0).
 *
 * @details If @p rc is not 0, the test fails and prints the message @p msg
 *          (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param rc The return code to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the return code is not 0.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_ok(rc, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((rc) != 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a return code indicates failure (not 0).
 *
 * @details If @p rc is 0, the test fails and prints the message @p msg
 *          (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param rc The return code to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the return code is 0.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_not_ok(rc, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((rc) == 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a code path is unreachable.
 *
 * @details If this macro is reached, the test fails and prints the message
 *          @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_unreachable(msg, ...) \
	do { \
		ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two pointers are equal.
 *
 * @details If @p actual is not equal to @p expected, the test fails and prints
 *          the message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The actual pointer value.
 * @param expected The expected pointer value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointers are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_equal_ptr(actual, expected, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((actual) != (expected)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two pointers are not equal.
 *
 * @details If @p actual is equal to @p expected, the test fails and prints
 *          the message @p msg (with optional format arguments).
 *
 * @param actual The actual pointer value.
 * @param expected The expected pointer value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointers are equal.
 * @param ... Optional format arguments for @p msg.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_ptr(actual, expected, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((actual) == (expected)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_ */
